name: Zoom
review:
A retro fruit game on 6x4 with 64 ways. Landing a Zoom symbol triggers a respin that expands into a special feature.

It's a simple fruit grid with a modern twist, and the Zoom respins are the moment you're waiting for. Low volatility, 1,500x cap, 96.2% RTP. Calm, easy to play and good for long sessions when you don't want to learn a list of features first.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
